description: Read one exact product_id or canonical slug from search_products. Returns existing public specifications, warranty, current AUD prices including and excluding GST, website supply status and KW product link. Missing/discontinued/hidden identities return product_not_found.

identity.description: Exact numeric product_id or canonical product slug returned by search_products. Use search_products for a SKU/model; no fuzzy identity lookup.

name: get_product
